name: single leg calf jump
description: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
